parent_objective: audit event-timing/source-state source result after bounded smoke remains zero-accepted
blocked_by: M1255 produced action-divergent low-regret evidence but accepted separable pairs remained zero
supersedes: another immediate event-timing source variant without a result audit

public_gates: M1256 must preserve actor input contract
M1256 must not use private holdout
M1256 must not lower capability-separable acceptance thresholds
M1256 must decide whether to stop the current event-timing source branch, synthesize, or pre-register a new source variable
forbidden_shortcuts: do not add hidden parameters, timing labels, proposal labels, oracle outcomes, or search outputs to actor inputs
do not accept negative own-branch margins
do not start another source run before audit

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: classifies the M1255 event-timing source-negative result before another source variable or run
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: process/source-result audit only; no training, promotion, private-holdout, paper-level, recurrent-belief, or self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop same event-timing variants if the audit finds only viable/action-equivalent or action-divergent/nonviable rows
stop if the next proposal is only more timing windows without a new evidence variable
fallback_plan: if current event timing is exhausted, synthesize the capability-separable source-construction branch and choose a broader source family or fidelity pivot
if a concrete under-specified source variable explains the result, pre-register exactly one bounded repair
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1255 remains zero-accepted and M1254 fallback requires audit

admission_evidence: M1255 produced trajectory proposals and rollouts with source timing overrides
M1255 found action-divergent/nonviable rows and one viable/action-equivalent row
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review
next_stage_criteria: audit chooses branch synthesis, one repair, or pivot

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1256 audits offline source-construction evidence and does not test actor history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: future actor history tests remain blocked until source-positive cases exist
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Record zero-accepted event-timing evidence as source-design evidence, not overall objective failure.
allowed_claims: no recurrent-belief, strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, real-vehicle, or paper-result claim

hypothesis: M1255 indicates the current event-timing source branch is not enough to produce accepted capability-separable rows and must be audited before another source run.
success_criteria: audit cites M1255 accepted_separable_pairs and result_class
audit chooses the next branch decision
no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, or actor-input expansion occurs
failure_criteria: audit proposes another timing run without a new evidence variable
training, PPO, private holdout, promotion, threshold relaxation, or actor-input expansion occurs
decision_rule: M1256 passes if it records the M1255 source-negative evidence and chooses the next branch without threshold relaxation or training.
